component.name: Nota
component.summary: Daily workplans and notes in plain markdown

description.p: Nota is built around one dated workplan per day. Unfinished items move to the new day keeping their identity and the time they were first added; finished ones stay on the day they were finished.
Every page is a plain markdown file in a directory you own, and that vault is the source of truth. Open a page in Kate, grep the whole tree or put it in git — none of it needs Nota running.

ul.li: A workplan for every day, created automatically
Rollover from the most recent workplan, so a weekend never breaks the chain
Keyboard-first items with nesting, labels and logged time
Items that repeat every day, in a section at the top
Folders that mirror the directory tree
Hours worked per day, and work, leave or holiday

description.p: First native KDE build: the vault, the note format and rollover, with a Kirigami window.
